title: A reference video, studied (what Claude writes)
description: study_reference.py: what a video the owner sent does second by second, why it works, and the recipe for doing the same with Kehai's footage in the editor. It is saved as a pattern (patterns/<name>.json). Structured-outputs subset: every field required.

name.description: The pattern's name: 2 to 5 lowercase words joined by dashes that say what it is, e.g. pov-she-already-knew.

title.description: The same in a few plain words, for Telegram.

summary.description: Two or three sentences: what the video does and how.

why_it_works.description: 2 to 5 reasons, each a short sentence.

on_screen.description: The hook's text as it appears ("" if none).

spoken.description: What's said in it ("" if nothing).

beats.description: The video in order, from 0 to its end, each beat a few seconds.

spoken.description: Speech in this beat ("" if none).

edit.description: How it's cut and moved: cuts, zooms, speed, transitions, sound.

shots.description: How many shots, as you count them.

average_shot.description: Seconds a shot lasts on average.

rhythm.description: How the pace moves: steady, speeding up into the turn, a pause before the payoff…

layout.description: Full frame, split, picture in picture, a meme layout…, and where things sit.

text.description: On-screen text: how much, where, how big, its style and timing.

captions.description: Captions of speech: word by word, lines, none; where; highlight.

motion.description: Zooms, pans, speed changes, freezes, shakes.

transitions.description: Hard cuts, or which transitions and where.

sound.description: Voice-over, music (and where it hits), effects, silence. Read from the transcript and loudness.

ending.description: How it ends: a payoff, a loop back to the start, a call to action.

recipe.description: Each element of the format, rebuilt with the editor: what to use and how, precisely enough to follow.

element.description: The part of the reference's format.

how.description: Exactly how: timing, position (x, y from the top left), size, text length, speed, zoom.

shots.description: The replay shots this format needs (1 to 4), from the game's cameras.

use.description: Which part of the format this shot serves.

missing.description: Parts of the format the editor can't do yet ([] if none), with the closest it can.

moments.description: The kind of shift moment this needs, so the week's picking can find one.

tags.description: Clip-marker tags that suit it (from the reference).

idea.description: One concrete Kehai short in this pattern, in a sentence or two.

avoid.description: What must not be copied from this video: its jokes, lines, characters, sounds, branding.
